subject: maths
prompt_en: Rain (mm) in a city: June 140, July 250, August 230, September 120. Why can't this table tell us whether it will rain on 15 July next year?
prompt_hi: Ek shehar mein baarish (mm): June 140, July 250, August 230, September 120. Yeh table yeh kyun nahi bata sakti ki agle saal 15 July ko baarish hogi ya nahi?
answer: It only has monthly totals for one year; it has no single days and nothing about the future

subject: maths
prompt_en: Riya noticed that students who sat in the front row got higher marks in one test. She says: 'Sitting in front makes you score more.' Check her claim.
prompt_hi: Riya ne dekha ki ek test mein aage baithne wale bachchon ke marks zyada aaye. Woh kehti hai: 'Aage baithne se marks badhte hain.' Uska claim check karo.
answer: Not proven: the data shows the two go together, not that one causes the other; keen students may choose the front, and it was only one test

subject: maths
prompt_en: Runs in three matches: Aarav 45, 12, 78; Kabir 30, 55, 60. Aarav says: 'I scored more runs in total, because my 78 is the highest.' Check.
prompt_hi: 3 matches ke runs: Aarav 45, 12, 78; Kabir 30, 55, 60. Aarav kehta hai: 'Total runs mere zyada hain, kyunki mera 78 sabse zyada hai.' Check karo.
answer: False: Aarav's total is 135 and Kabir's is 145; one high score does not decide the total

subject: maths
prompt_en: Turn this claim into a question and say what data you would collect: 'More children in our class walk to school than come by bus.'
prompt_hi: Is claim ko ek sawaal mein badlo aur batao kaunsa data ikattha karoge: 'Hamari class mein bus se zyada bachche paidal school aate hain.'
answer: Question: How do children in our class come to school? Data: a tally of each child's way (walk, bus, cycle, auto…), then compare walk and bus

subject: maths
prompt_en: You ask 5 friends and 4 of them like mango ice-cream. Predict: can you say 80% of children in India like mango ice-cream?
prompt_hi: Tumne 5 doston se poocha aur 4 ko mango ice-cream pasand hai. Andaaza lagao: kya keh sakte ho ki India ke 80% bachchon ko mango ice-cream pasand hai?
answer: No: 5 friends are too few and are not like all children in India

subject: maths
prompt_en: The school canteen wants to know whether to make more idli or more poha. What question would you ask, and what data would you collect?
prompt_hi: School canteen jaanna chahti hai ki idli zyada banaye ya poha. Tum kya sawaal poochoge aur kaunsa data ikattha karoge?
answer: Ask which is chosen more; record how many plates of each are sold every day for a couple of weeks and compare the totals

subject: maths
prompt_en: Teach a friend how to check a statement using a table of data.
prompt_hi: Dost ko sikhao ki data ki table se statement kaise check karte hain.
answer: Find the numbers the statement talks about, compare them, then decide true, false, or 'cannot tell from this data' if those numbers are not there

subject: maths
prompt_en: From memory: what three answers can a statement get when you check it against data?
prompt_hi: Yaad se: data se check karne par statement ke 3 kaunse jawab ho sakte hain?
answer: True, false, or cannot tell from this data

subject: maths
prompt_en: A batter scores 32, 45, 18, 60 and 25 runs in five matches. What are the average runs per match?
prompt_hi: Ek batter paanch matches mein 32, 45, 18, 60 aur 25 runs banata hai. Har match ka average kitna?
answer: 36 runs

subject: maths
prompt_en: Find the median of 9, 2, 7, 4, 5.
prompt_hi: 9, 2, 7, 4, 5 ka median nikaalo.

subject: maths
prompt_en: Find the median of 3, 8, 5, 12.
prompt_hi: 3, 8, 5, 12 ka median nikaalo.
answer: 6.5: in order 3, 5, 8, 12; the middle two are 5 and 8, and (5 + 8) ÷ 2 = 6.5

subject: maths
prompt_en: Shoe sizes in a group: 5, 6, 6, 7, 6, 8, 5. What is the mode?
prompt_hi: Ek group ke joote ke size: 5, 6, 6, 7, 6, 8, 5. Mode kya hai?
answer: 6 (it occurs 3 times)

subject: maths
prompt_en: The mean of 4, 7, 10 and 11 is 8, but 8 is not in the list. Why is that fine?
prompt_hi: 4, 7, 10 aur 11 ka mean 8 hai, par 8 list mein nahi hai. Yeh theek kyun hai?
answer: The mean is the equal share of the total (32 ÷ 4 = 8); levelling out the values can give a number none of them had

subject: maths
prompt_en: Five people earn ₹12,000, ₹13,000, ₹14,000, ₹15,000 and ₹96,000. Find the mean and the median. Which describes a typical person better?
prompt_hi: Paanch log ₹12,000, ₹13,000, ₹14,000, ₹15,000 aur ₹96,000 kamaate hain. Mean aur median nikaalo. Typical insaan ko kaun behtar batata hai?
answer: Mean ₹30,000, median ₹14,000; the median is better because the one large salary pulls the mean up

subject: maths
prompt_en: The mean of 5 numbers is 10. Predict what happens to the mean if a sixth number, 40, is added. Then find it.
prompt_hi: 5 numbers ka mean 10 hai. Andaaza lagao, chhatha number 40 jodne par mean ka kya hoga. Phir nikaalo.
answer: It goes up to 15: total 50 + 40 = 90, and 90 ÷ 6 = 15

subject: maths
prompt_en: Kiran says the mean of 2, 4 and 9 must be 4, because the mean is always the middle number. Check.
prompt_hi: Kiran kehta hai 2, 4 aur 9 ka mean 4 hi hoga, kyunki mean hamesha beech wala number hota hai. Check karo.
answer: Wrong: mean = 15 ÷ 3 = 5; 4 is the median, not the mean

subject: maths
prompt_en: Maximum temperatures in a week (°C): 30, 32, 31, 29, 33, 35, 34. What is the mean temperature?
prompt_hi: Ek hafte ka sabse zyada taapmaan (°C): 30, 32, 31, 29, 33, 35, 34. Mean taapmaan kya hai?

subject: maths
prompt_en: A shoe shop wants to know which size to keep the most of. Should it use the mean, median or mode of customers' sizes? Why?
prompt_hi: Ek joote ki dukaan jaanna chahti hai ki kaunsa size sabse zyada rakhe. Customers ke size ka mean, median ya mode use kare? Kyun?
answer: The mode: it is the size most people buy; a mean like 6.4 is not even a real size

subject: maths
prompt_en: Towers of 3, 5, 7 and 9 blocks are levelled so all are equal. How tall is each tower? What is this number called?
prompt_hi: 3, 5, 7 aur 9 blocks ke towers ko barabar kar diya. Har tower kitna ooncha hoga? Is number ko kya kehte hain?
answer: 6 blocks each; it is the mean (24 ÷ 4)

subject: maths
prompt_en: Teach a friend the difference between mean, median and mode, and when to use each.
prompt_hi: Dost ko mean, median aur mode ka farak sikhao, aur kab kaunsa use karein.
answer: Mean: total ÷ count, uses every value but is pulled by extremes; median: middle of the ordered data, good when there are extremes; mode: most frequent, good for things like sizes or favourite choices

subject: maths
prompt_en: From memory: median of 1, 3, 3, 6, 7?
prompt_hi: Yaad se: 1, 3, 3, 6, 7 ka median?

subject: maths
prompt_en: A double bar graph of favourite games in class 7 (blue = boys, orange = girls): cricket 12 and 7, kho-kho 5 and 9, badminton 7 and 10, football 6 and 3. How many children in all chose kho-kho?
prompt_hi: Class 7 ke favourite games ka double bar graph (neela = ladke, naarangi = ladkiyan): cricket 12 aur 7, kho-kho 5 aur 9, badminton 7 aur 10, football 6 aur 3. Kul kitne bachchon ne kho-kho chuna?
answer: 14 (5 boys + 9 girls)

subject: maths
prompt_en: A double bar graph of favourite games in class 7 (blue = boys, orange = girls): cricket 12 and 7, kho-kho 5 and 9, badminton 7 and 10, football 6 and 3. For which game is the gap between boys and girls the biggest?
prompt_hi: Class 7 ke favourite games ka double bar graph (neela = ladke, naarangi = ladkiyan): cricket 12 aur 7, kho-kho 5 aur 9, badminton 7 aur 10, football 6 aur 3. Kis game mein ladkon aur ladkiyon ke beech sabse bada farak hai?
answer: Cricket: 12 − 7 = 5

subject: maths
prompt_en: Two graphs show the same marks, 92 and 96. In graph P the axis starts at 0; in graph Q it starts at 90. Which one makes the difference look big, and which is honest?
prompt_hi: Do graph ek hi marks dikhate hain, 92 aur 96. Graph P ka axis 0 se shuru hai; graph Q ka 90 se. Kaunsa farak bada dikhata hai, aur kaunsa imaandaar hai?
answer: Q makes 96 look three times 92 (6 vs 2 above 90); P is honest and shows the marks are close

subject: maths
prompt_en: An advert's graph shows Brand X at 50% and Brand Y at 48%, with the axis starting at 45%. X's bar looks almost twice as tall. The advert says 'X is far better.' Check.
prompt_hi: Ek advert ke graph mein Brand X 50% aur Brand Y 48% hai, axis 45% se shuru hota hai. X ka bar lagbhag double dikhta hai. Advert kehta hai 'X bahut behtar hai.' Check karo.
answer: Misleading: the difference is only 2 percentage points; the cut axis makes it look large

subject: maths
prompt_en: Your largest value is 240 and your graph has 12 squares of height. What is a good scale, one square = ?
prompt_hi: Tumhara sabse bada value 240 hai aur graph mein 12 squares ki height hai. Achha scale kya hoga, ek square = ?
answer: 1 square = 20

subject: maths
prompt_en: Why must the steps on a graph's axis be equal?
prompt_hi: Graph ke axis ke steps barabar kyun hone chahiye?
answer: So that equal distances stand for equal amounts; otherwise bar heights mislead

subject: maths
prompt_en: A double bar graph of favourite games in class 7 (blue = boys, orange = girls): cricket 12 and 7, kho-kho 5 and 9, badminton 7 and 10, football 6 and 3. Ankit says 12 girls chose cricket. Check.
prompt_hi: Class 7 ke favourite games ka double bar graph (neela = ladke, naarangi = ladkiyan): cricket 12 aur 7, kho-kho 5 aur 9, badminton 7 aur 10, football 6 aur 3. Ankit kehta hai 12 ladkiyon ne cricket chuna. Check karo.
answer: Wrong: 12 is the boys' (blue) bar; 7 girls chose cricket

subject: maths
prompt_en: Sales were 98 and 102. Predict how the bars look if the axis starts at 95, and if it starts at 0.
prompt_hi: Bikri 98 aur 102 thi. Andaaza lagao: axis 95 se shuru ho toh bar kaise dikhenge, aur 0 se shuru ho toh?
answer: From 95, the 102 bar looks more than twice as tall (7 vs 3); from 0 the bars look almost equal

subject: maths
prompt_en: Plan a double bar graph for rainfall (mm) over three months: Pune 120, 180, 150; Chennai 40, 60, 110. What goes on each axis, what scale, and what does the legend show?
prompt_hi: 3 mahine ki baarish (mm) ke liye double bar graph plan karo: Pune 120, 180, 150; Chennai 40, 60, 110. Kaunse axis par kya, scale kya, aur legend kya dikhayega?
answer: Months on the horizontal axis, rainfall in mm on the vertical axis from 0 in equal steps (e.g. 20 mm), two bars per month, legend: one colour Pune, one colour Chennai

subject: maths
prompt_en: A magazine shows that phone sales doubled, using a phone picture made twice as tall AND twice as wide. Why is this misleading?
prompt_hi: Ek magazine dikhati hai ki phone ki bikri double hui, phone ki tasveer ko double lamba AUR double chauda karke. Yeh misleading kyun hai?
answer: Twice as tall and twice as wide covers 4 times the area, so it looks like 4 times the sales, not 2

subject: maths
prompt_en: Teach a friend a checklist for deciding whether to trust a graph.
prompt_hi: Dost ko ek checklist sikhao ki kisi graph par bharosa karein ya nahi.
answer: Read the title and labels, check the axis starts at 0 and has equal steps, read the legend, and compare the actual numbers rather than the look

subject: maths
prompt_en: From memory: in a double bar graph, what tells you which bar belongs to which group?
prompt_hi: Yaad se: double bar graph mein kaun batata hai ki kaunsa bar kis group ka hai?
answer: The legend (key)

subject: maths
prompt_en: Why is every point on the perpendicular bisector of AB equally far from A and B?
prompt_hi: AB ke perpendicular bisector ka har point A aur B se barabar doori par kyun hota hai?
answer: The crossing points are the same radius from A and B; for any point P on the line, triangles PMA and PMB are congruent (PM common, MA = MB, right angles at M), so PA = PB

subject: maths
prompt_en: AB is 8 cm and your compass is opened to 3 cm. Predict: will the arcs from A and B cross?
prompt_hi: AB 8 cm hai aur compass 3 cm khula hai. Andaaza lagao: kya A aur B ke arcs katenge?
answer: No: 3 + 3 = 6 is less than 8; the width must be more than 4 cm

subject: maths
prompt_en: Say the steps to bisect an angle with ruler and compass.
prompt_hi: Ruler aur compass se angle bisect karne ke steps batao.
answer: Arc from the vertex cutting both arms; from those two points draw equal arcs that cross; join the vertex to the crossing

subject: maths
prompt_en: How do you construct a 60° angle with ruler and compass?
prompt_hi: Ruler aur compass se 60° ka angle kaise banate hain?
answer: Draw a ray from O; arc from O cuts it at A; same width arc from A cuts the first arc at B; join OB; angle AOB = 60° (triangle OAB is equilateral)

subject: maths
prompt_en: How can you construct a 30° angle?
prompt_hi: 30° ka angle kaise banaoge?
answer: Construct 60°, then bisect it to get 30°

subject: maths
prompt_en: How can you construct a 45° angle?
prompt_hi: 45° ka angle kaise banaoge?
answer: Construct a 90° angle (a perpendicular), then bisect it

subject: maths
prompt_en: Sana 'bisected' a 70° angle by measuring 35° with a protractor and called it a construction. Check.
prompt_hi: Sana ne 70° ke angle ko protractor se 35° naap kar 'bisect' kiya aur use construction kaha. Check karo.
answer: Not a construction: she measured; a construction uses only compass and straightedge and works for any angle without reading a scale
